content: mini-sglang (HEAD 9a91cfa, 2026-05-17) uses ZMQ PUSH/PULL over ipc:///tmp/minisgl_N.pid=<launcher pid> with msgpack maps tagged by Python class name (__type__), tensors as {__type__:Tensor,buffer:bytes,dtype:'torch.int32'}; scheduler pulls UserMsg/AbortBackendMsg/ExitMsg and pushes per-token DetokenizeMsg(uid,next_token,finished); dataclass deserialization cls(**kwargs) rejects unknown fields; no abort ack; over-length requests dropped silently; radix cache lives inside scheduler bound to KV page indices.
